svg.text: Every symbol that appears in the loop. Read this first if the notation is unfamiliar.
Everything the system can currently express: its primitives, and everything it can build by
The terms in the library that were not built from anything else. The floor of what it can say.
Everything expressible by combining the primitives, at any depth. What the system could say if
What the system takes to be the case before it acts. Formed from its own history and from what
it inherited, mixed by w. Not the observation.
How far the belief leans on private history versus inherited prior. w_A + w_B = 1, and w is
learnable from the outcomes of past weightings. Two frames with identical architecture diverge
because their histories and their w diverge.
What the library says should happen, given belief b and action a.
The gap between prediction and observation. The central quantity: everything the system does is
driven by it. It is the aim, not only the error signal, and it is always a slice: what cannot be
perceived yet is residual and simply cannot be read.
One object, region or entity being tracked. R is measured per slot, never as a single global
The part of the residual on slot s that is positive: something happened there the prediction
A new predicate the system is considering adding to the library. Read phi.
How much it costs to state φ, under a declared code. Also written cost(φ). Charges the atoms and
How much residual remains once φ explains what it can. Also written left(R,φ). May be greater
The typed relation between two operands. Seven of them, and which one holds is not recoverable
from the operands, so a term naming only its ingredients has recorded half of itself.
Any composition of atoms and the bonds between them. A chain is the degenerate case: one bond
Abstraction. Detail is thrown away, which is what makes the result reusable. Written α in
Concretisation. Putting an abstract result back into a specific situation. Written γ.
The gap between what was sent up and what came back down: gap(x, (T_E ∘ T_A)(x)). Measures what
The map between allocentric and egocentric at one scale. Distinct from T_A and T_E, which run
between scales. Cannot be run without a pose.
Near, far, between, contained. One of the six the loop assumes throughout.
Conserved, finite, and directionless on its own.
Ordering, so that more and less can be said.
A difference that can be spent. Not merely a distribution: what makes it a gradient is
That entities relate at all, and that influence travels between them.
Whatever settles the question and does not change its answer because of what any frame thinks.
It is not a frame and has no vantage to update from. Not in the library; the loop cannot modify
Everything in contact with the residual: actors, conditions, relations. Enumerated, never
A frame is any bounded system with a library: an agent, a person, a discipline, a model. It is a theory with a signature rather than a coordinate
system, so frames differ in what they can express and not in how they label it, and there is no known transform between two of them.
A seat is a position in a checking arrangement, defined by what it can and cannot see rather than by who occupies it.
The six terms under the rule are the substrate the loop assumes throughout: three states, three structures, indivisible and minimal. Set out in Figure 13.
